c.request: Looking at scans taken between '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' (comparing `chronotag` as text) that link to a site via `zoneref`, break them down by the site's health and safety status (`healtheval`). For each status, give the status, the total `scancount`, and the average GB per scan minute (`gbsize` ÷ `spanmin`), skipping missing values. Also give each status's gap from the mean of those status-level averages (its average minus the mean), and return nothing if that mean can't be computed. No rounding. Only scans timestamped strictly inside the window are included; scans exactly at either endpoint are excluded.
c.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scancount, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_scan_minute FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE CAST(sc.chronotag AS text) > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND CAST(sc.chronotag AS text) < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_scan_minute) AS mean_status_average FROM status_averages) SELECT sa.status, sa.total_scancount, sa.avg_gb_per_scan_minute, sa.avg_gb_per_scan_minute - o.mean_status_average AS gap_from_mean FROM status_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_status_average IS NOT NULL

b.request: For scans whose `chronotag`, compared as text, is strictly greater than '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and strictly less than '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797', join `scans.zoneref` to `sites.zoneregistry` and group by `sites.healtheval`; return each status, the sum of `scancount`, the average of `gbsize / spanmin` excluding missing values, and that average minus the mean of all computable status-level averages; return no rows if that mean cannot be computed, without rounding.
b.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_minute FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY si.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS mean_status_average FROM status_averages) SELECT sa.status, sa.total_scans, sa.avg_gb_per_minute, sa.avg_gb_per_minute - o.mean_status_average AS difference_from_mean FROM status_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_status_average IS NOT NULL

d.request: For each site health and safety status, use scans whose `chronotag`, compared as text, is strictly greater than '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and strictly less than '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' and whose `zoneref` matches a site; return the status, sum of `scancount`, average of `gbsize / spanmin` over nonmissing values, and that average minus the mean of all computable status-level averages, with no rounding and no rows if the mean cannot be computed.
d.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_minute FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.healtheval), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS mean_status_average FROM status_averages) SELECT sa.status, sa.total_scans, sa.avg_gb_per_minute, sa.avg_gb_per_minute - om.mean_status_average AS difference_from_mean FROM status_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om WHERE om.mean_status_average IS NOT NULL

a.request: For scans linked to a site (scan `zoneref` = site code) with a timestamp (`chronotag`, compared as text) strictly after '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and strictly before '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797', excluding both endpoints, group by the site's health and safety status (`healtheval`). For each status, show the status, the total number of scans (sum of `scancount`) and the average file size per scan minute (`gbsize` ÷ `spanmin`), ignoring missing values. Also show how far each status's average ratio is from the mean of all the status-level average ratios (status average minus that mean), and return nothing if that mean can't be computed. Don't round.
a.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS health_safety_status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS average_gb_per_minute FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE sc.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND sc.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY si.healtheval), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_gb_per_minute) AS mean_ratio FROM status_averages) SELECT sa.health_safety_status, sa.total_scans, sa.average_gb_per_minute, sa.average_gb_per_minute - om.mean_ratio AS difference_from_mean FROM status_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om WHERE om.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL;
